correctness.rationale: A direct algebraic proof partitions the full radical by the first nonzero graded component. Nonzero linear parts are conjugate to one generator, of rank eight. For nonzero quadratic leading terms, the degree filtration gives rank two plus the rank of a four-dimensional alternating matrix, which is two or four according to the Pfaffian. Its rank-two matrices number (q^2+1)(q^3-1), and the complementary rank-four matrices number q^2(q-1)(q^3-1). Cubic, quartic and zero cases give ranks two, one and zero. Five free higher coefficients give the announced uniform field counts, totaling q^15. A standalone checker exhausts all 32768 binary radical elements and all 4096 quaternary quadratic elements, plus nonhomogeneous samples; the proof, not finite testing, handles all characteristic-two fields.

value.rationale: Jordan types of multiplication operators are canonical invariants of Artinian rings and their regular modular representations. Every radical element of the group algebra of (C_2)^4 squares to zero, so the ordinary nilpotency exponent conceals distinctions that its full rank distribution resolves. Four generators form the first natural exterior-algebra case where nonzero quadratic leading terms split into two ranks, with an explicit Pfaffian quadric and full algebraic closure chain. The theorem supplies the exact field-uniform frequency of every Jordan type as well as the geometry of the exceptional locus; it is more than an isolated unmotivated count.
